engine: A7 exterior before/after SECTION — a thin orchestrator over the day/night CANON (window.DayNight, reveal:'seam'). A draggable vertical seam wipes the house from cold afternoon into warm evening; the seam reads as the EVENING FRONT advancing across the facade. set(t) is PURE (0 = all afternoon, 1 = all evening; the seam sits at x = t). One t drives the canon's seam clip (clip-path inset peeling the evening still in from the swept side), a per-window warm-glow group CLIPPED to the swept evening side, and each window's ignition as the seam clears its centre. NO WebGL, NO mix-blend, NO backdrop-filter, NO canvas — clip-path / opacity / transform / gradient only.

drives_canon_with.note: seamFrom:'right' makes the evening (night) fill the region the seam has SWEPT past (to its LEFT) and grow as the seam is dragged right — the seam is the evening front. The canon owns the clip; the section owns the handle + the seam-bound window ignition. labels[0]='Вечір' lands bottom-left (the swept/lit side), labels[1]='День' bottom-right (the unswept day side), matching what is shown.

dayMedia.what: url | selector | element — the afternoon still (canon day side).

nightMedia.what: url | selector | element — the evening still, geometry-identical; supplies the seam reveal AND the per-window glow crops.

windows.what: [{ x,y,w,h }] in % of the stage, x-ordered left->right; each ignites just after the seam clears its centre. Calibrated to THIS render's warm lower-middle band.

start.what: initial seam x. The lab opens at 0.42 then autoplays a sweep.

onUpdate.what: (t) => {} — app-side sync (e.g. a live evening-percent readout).

mechanic.seam_clip: the canon: dn.set(t) -> .dn__night clip-path inset(0 (1-t)*100% 0 0); night fills the swept region to the LEFT of the seam.
mechanic.glow_group_clip: the whole .ohd__glows group is clipped inset(0 (1-t)*100% 0 0) (same swept region), so warmth appears ONLY where the seam has passed.
mechanic.window_ignition: per window: opacity = smoothstep((t - windowCentreX) / 0.05); 0 AT the seam, full a touch past it, so the light trails the front and never leads it. Left-to-right in seam order.
mechanic.reduced_motion: apply(0.5): the seam parks mid-frame as two static halves (evening left | day right), contrast visible, drag disarmed; the lockup copy is reframed from an instruction to a description.

--brass.what: the seam line + the handle focus ring.

--cream.what: the round grip + the seam hairline.

grip.what: the draggable seam handle; ew-resize cursor; focus ring in brass.

scrim.what: keeps the white lockup legible over the bright day side (the master's caption-over-bright lesson).

z_order.default: day(1) < night(2,seam-clipped) < glow-group(4,seam-clipped) < scrim(7) < handle(7) < lockup(8)
z_order.what: warmth above the night layer; lockup above the scrim.

crop_math.background-size: (10000 / w)% x (10000 / h)% — sizes the evening image to the WHOLE stage so each window box shows its slice at 1:1 registration.
crop_math.background-position: (x / (100 - w) * 100)% x (y / (100 - h) * 100)% — maps a box's % offset to the matching crop.

entry: OurHouseAtDusk.create(target, opts) -> { root, dn, set(t), get(), tweenTo(t), windows, destroy }. set(t) PURE 0..1 = seam x; tweenTo eases the seam (buttons / click-to-x). REQUIRES window.DayNight loaded first.
law: clip-path / opacity / transform / gradient only; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL / NO canvas drawImage. Frame-match rule inherited. role=slider with live aria-valuenow/valuetext; ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down nudge, Home/End glide. prefers-reduced-motion -> two static halves (seam at 0.5), drag disarmed, copy reframed. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
proven: lab: OUR exterior day/night pair (renders/dn-ext-day.webp + dn-ext-night.webp), 16:9 zero-crop surface. Headless: __LAB_OK__ true, 0 console errors, both stills loaded; .dn__night clip inset(0 100%)->inset(0 0%) (canon owns the seam), glow group clip tracks the seam, central window opacity 0 AT its centre / 1 just past (ignition trails the front), labels Вечір-left/День-right, aria-valuenow/valuetext set, demo does not fight a grab, reduced-motion parks at t=0.5 with reframed copy, zero em-dash. t=0 full day, t=1 full evening (all windows lit). Smoothness @4x CPU: 60fps, 0% jank (PASS). Skeptic found NO critical; both MAJORs + targeted MINORs fixed + re-verified.
